items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: he sent and got Swayzee and the rest of those boys, called themselves the Syncopated Six.

ctx.x: Crowded. Well, I told the man, I says, "I have a very fine guitarist I know of back in Durham, North Carolina. I'd like to add him in the band here." So, the man told me to send and get him. So, I sent and got him and his name was Joseph Patterson. You'll read about that though, in that book about Patterson. So, I had Patterson, and I sent for Patterson and that's where we played. (unintelligible) Then we were trying -- and there was another place -- that man was about to go out of business, so he sent and got…
